pitch.heading: Rejoinder
pitch.text: Rejoinder stands on the lip of the Reply, a canyon that gives back whatever is shouted into it after a year. Tonight is Return Night: the year's voices come back in the order they were shouted, each to the cairn it left from. A widow wants wool for hers. A Caller has sent a proposal to the wrong cairn. A farmer's son has come home to hear whether he was ever called. Nobody in Rejoinder may tell anybody anything, and you are strangers.
